_doc: #868 THE nav-shape ledger. Every app's navigation is ONE declaration in build.json::ui (bottom_nav ids <= 5, sections[].pages[] with optional pages[] one strip lower, default_section) drawn by libs:bottomnav (BottomNavIsland/BottomNavIslandView for the bar, PageTabs/PageTabsView for the pill strips) and read through NavDecl. Read by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-nav-shape-guard.py (nav-shape-guard.yml). THE BASELINE IS ALL-EXEMPT: no app has migrated yet, so every app below is exempt WITH THE REASON it is, and the guard is green today. Each migration batch removes its apps' entries in the same commit it lands, and from then on the app is held to N1-N5. Removing an entry is the only way to opt an app IN; adding one needs a reason a reviewer can disagree with.
_doc_rules: N1 ui.bottom_nav is at most 5 ids, each a ui.sections id, and ui.default_section is one of them. N2 the app compiles libs:bottomnav (a project dependency in its gradle scripts, or build.json modules). N3 no hand-rolled nav widget in the app's sources (forbidden below), comments blanked first so prose about a widget is not the widget. N4 the app's build.gradle bakes UI_BOTTOM_NAV and UI_SECTIONS_B64, and no id literal in Kotlin (id_calls, 'page:<section>/<page>') names a section or page build.json does not declare. N5 a section with two or more pages (or a page with two or more sub-pages) is drawn by PageTabs/PageTabsView. N6 every exemption carries a reason, names a real app, and an exempt app that already passes N1-N5 is stale (it migrated: delete the exemption). N0 libs:bottomnav still ships NavDecl, PageTabs and PageTabsView.
